baseline_parent.interpretation: Q037 validated that the CamSpec-HiLLiPoP difference survives exact common TT support; Q041 starts from that harmonized support rather than reopening Q040.

classification.equivalent_if: For P_A6_L6_D2, all standardized coordinate shifts <= 0.50 AND six-dimensional Gaussian Bhattacharyya coefficient >= 0.80, with all three leave-one-out max shifts <= 0.75.
classification.material_if: For P_A6_L6_D2, max standardized two-arm mean shift >= 1.0 OR six-dimensional Gaussian Bhattacharyya coefficient <= 0.50, and at least two of three leave-one-out combinations preserve max standardized shift >= 0.75.

external_data.A6: ACT DR6 foreground-marginalized primary CMB, official DR6-ACT-lite v1.0.1
external_data.D2: DESI DR2 all-tracer BAO through the Cobaya desi_dr2 definition and bao_data v2.6
external_data.L6: ACT DR6 ACT-only baseline lensing likelihood v1.2.1

overlap_policy.name: CONSERVATIVE_PRIMARY_CMB_NONOVERLAP
overlap_policy.when_A6_absent: Use the full authoritative Q032 exact-common TT support.
overlap_policy.when_A6_present: Planck exact-common TT support is further marginalized to ell <= 599; ACT primary TT/TE/EE starts at ell = 600.

scientific_question: Does the validated CamSpec-HiLLiPoP fitted-geometry difference in n=3 EDE produce materially different cosmological inference after combining each native Planck arm with the same external CMB and late-time information?

technical_revision.reason: V16 correctly isolated one chain lineage, but same-series HiLLiPoP continuation still failed because Cobaya re-resolved planck_2020_hillipop.TT and judged that newly resolved component information incompatible with the component serialized in chain.updated.yaml. V17 migrates only the locked V16 lineage, feeds Cobaya the exact serialized HiLLiPoP TT component before resume, and preserves the original per-chain eight-compute-segment budget. No --allow-changes bypass is used.
